title: Monthly Review
description: One month, in context. Pick the month above - this dashboard is driven by that selector, not by the time picker, so the comparisons can reach outside the month. The budget strip and everything below it except the donut and the ledger stay whole-month: a review of one month's finances should not quietly become a review of one category. For envelope balances, pacing and plan history, see the Budget dashboard - those questions have no month.

list.name: account
list.label: Accounts
list.query: SELECT name FROM accounts ORDER BY name

list.name: month
list.label: Month
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT to_char(date_trunc('month', posted_on), 'YYYY-MM') AS month FROM transactions WHERE status <> 'void' ORDER BY 1 DESC

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT roll1 FROM v_transactions ORDER BY 1

list.name: subcategory
list.label: Subcategory
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT roll2 FROM v_transactions WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) ORDER BY 1

list.name: subdivision
list.label: Subdivision
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT roll3 FROM v_transactions WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Income
panels.description: Money from outside in the selected month. Not affected by the category selectors - this is a whole-month figure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(inflow) AS "Income"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Spending
panels.description: Money out, internal movement excluded. Whole month, whatever the category selectors say.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(outflow) AS "Spending"
FROM v_spending WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Net
panels.description: What the month added to, or took from, your finances.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(inflow) - sum(outflow) AS "Net"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Savings Rate
panels.description: Share of this month's income you did not spend.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * (sum(inflow) - sum(outflow))
                 / nullif(sum(inflow), 0), 1) AS "Savings rate"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE NOT is_internal AND (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Spending Vs. Last Month
panels.description: Up is red: you spent more than the month before. Empty when there is no previous month to compare with.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', posted_on) AS m, sum(outflow) AS spend
    FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) IN (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM'), (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month'))
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT round(100.0 * (coalesce(max(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0)
                      - max(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month')))
             / nullif(max(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month')), 0), 1)
           AS "vs last month"
FROM s

panels.title: Spending Vs. Quarterly Average
panels.description: Against the average of the three months before this one, which is steadier than a single month's comparison.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
    SELECT sum(outflow) AS spend FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
), prior AS (
    SELECT sum(outflow) / nullif(count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', posted_on)), 0)
           AS avg_spend
    FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
      AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) >= to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '3 months'
      AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) <  to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
)
SELECT round(100.0 * (cur.spend - prior.avg_spend)
             / nullif(prior.avg_spend, 0), 1) AS "vs 3-month average"
FROM cur, prior

panels.title: Budgeted
panels.description: What the plans add up to for the month under review - the accrued figure, so an annual bill contributes a twelfth. Budgets sit on whole categories across every account, so this panel ignores the Accounts, Category, Subcategory and Subdivision selectors - narrowing them would shrink the spending without shrinking the budget.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(budget) AS "Budgeted"
FROM v_budget_vs_actual WHERE month = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Budget Against Actual
panels.description: Every category with a plan in effect for the month. Kind is the difference that matters: a monthly category is judged on the month alone, while an envelope category accrues, so read its Envelope column rather than Left - that is the fund balance after this month. Override marks a month whose budget came from the budgets table instead of the plan. Budgets sit on whole categories across every account, so this panel ignores the Accounts, Category, Subcategory and Subdivision selectors - narrowing them would shrink the spending without shrinking the budget.

targets.rawSql:
WITH b AS (
    SELECT category, carry_forward, budget, spent, variance, pct_used,
           envelope_balance, is_override
    FROM v_budget_vs_actual
    WHERE month = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
)
SELECT category AS "Category",
       CASE WHEN carry_forward THEN 'envelope' ELSE 'monthly' END AS "Kind",
       budget           AS "Budget",
       spent            AS "Spent",
       variance         AS "Left",
       pct_used         AS "% used",
       envelope_balance AS "Envelope",
       CASE WHEN is_override THEN 'yes' END AS "Override"
FROM b
UNION ALL
SELECT 'No budget plan in effect for this month',
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM b)
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Spent Against Budget
panels.description: Spending that landed in a budgeted category or any of its descendants. Spending in categories you have not budgeted is not counted here - the Spending tile above is the whole-month number. Budgets sit on whole categories across every account, so this panel ignores the Accounts, Category, Subcategory and Subdivision selectors - narrowing them would shrink the spending without shrinking the budget.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(spent) AS "Spent"
FROM v_budget_vs_actual WHERE month = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Budgeted Remaining
panels.description: Budgeted minus spent. Negative means the month went over in total, which can still hide an over-budget category when another came in under. Budgets sit on whole categories across every account, so this panel ignores the Accounts, Category, Subcategory and Subdivision selectors - narrowing them would shrink the spending without shrinking the budget.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(variance) AS "Left"
FROM v_budget_vs_actual WHERE month = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Categories Over Budget
panels.description: Categories needing a look. A monthly category counts when it outspent its budget; an envelope category counts only when it ran dry - spent past everything it had accrued - because spending more than one month's accrual is exactly what happens in the month the bill lands, and an envelope balance is floored at zero so it can never read negative. Budgets sit on whole categories across every account, so this panel ignores the Accounts, Category, Subcategory and Subdivision selectors - narrowing them would shrink the spending without shrinking the budget.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE count(*) FILTER (
                WHERE CASE WHEN carry_forward THEN envelope_shortfall > 0
                           ELSE spent > budget END)
       END AS "Over budget"
FROM v_budget_vs_actual WHERE month = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')

panels.title: Month by Categories
panels.description: Follows the Category, Subcategory and Subdivision selectors, and groups at the deepest level that still has more than one slice: top-level categories with everything selected, subcategories once you pick a category, subdivisions once you pick a subcategory.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT roll1, roll2, roll3, outflow
    FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
), depth AS (
    -- The deepest level that still distinguishes rows, so narrowing the
    -- selectors drills down instead of leaving one slice.
    SELECT CASE WHEN count(DISTINCT roll1) > 1 THEN 1
                WHEN count(DISTINCT roll2) > 1 THEN 2
                ELSE 3 END AS lvl
    FROM filtered
), totals AS (
    SELECT CASE depth.lvl WHEN 1 THEN roll1 WHEN 2 THEN roll2 ELSE roll3 END
               AS metric,
           sum(outflow) AS value
    FROM filtered, depth
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT metric, value
FROM totals ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Spending Day to Day
panels.description: Where the month's money actually went out. Clusters usually mark a bill run or a trip. Whole month, not category-filtered.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "time",
       sum(outflow) AS "Spending"
FROM v_spending WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Category Monthly Comparison
panels.description: The heart of a review, and deliberately whole-month: it compares every category, so the selectors do not narrow it. A blank Change means the category had no spending last month - new, or returning.

targets.rawSql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT roll1 AS category,
           date_trunc('month', posted_on) AS m,
           sum(outflow) AS spend
    FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
      AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) >= to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '3 months'
      AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) <= to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category AS "Category",
       coalesce(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0)  AS "This month",
       coalesce(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month')), 0)   AS "Last month",
       round(100.0 * (coalesce(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0)
                      - sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month')))
             / nullif(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month')), 0), 1)
           AS "Change %",
       round(avg(spend) FILTER (WHERE m < to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 2)     AS "3-month average",
       round(100.0 * (coalesce(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0)
                      - avg(spend) FILTER (WHERE m < to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')))
             / nullif(avg(spend) FILTER (WHERE m < to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0), 1)
           AS "vs average %"
FROM months
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Month in Context
panels.description: The thirteen months up to the one selected, so the month you are reviewing is the last bar. The line smooths out single-month noise.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', posted_on) AS month, sum(outflow) AS spend
    FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
      AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) >  to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '13 months'
      AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) <= to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT (month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver') AS "time",
       spend AS "Spending",
       round(avg(spend) OVER (ORDER BY month
                              ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2)
           AS "3-month moving average"
FROM m ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Biggest Movers Vs. Last Month
panels.description: What actually moved, by subcategory and in dollars. Positive means you spent more than last month.

targets.rawSql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT roll2 AS category,
           date_trunc('month', posted_on) AS m,
           sum(outflow) AS spend
    FROM v_spending
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) IN (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM'), (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month'))
    GROUP BY 1, 2
), diff AS (
    SELECT category,
           coalesce(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0)
             - coalesce(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE m = (to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') - interval '1 month')), 0) AS change
    FROM months GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category AS "Subcategory", change AS "Change"
FROM diff
WHERE change <> 0
ORDER BY abs(change) DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: New Merchants
panels.description: Merchants with no history before this month. Worth a look every review: this is where new subscriptions and one-off splurges show up.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(merchant, '(no merchant yet)') AS "Merchant",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM'))     AS "Transactions",
       sum(outflow) FILTER (WHERE date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')) AS "Spent",
       to_char(min(posted_on), 'YYYY-MM-DD')    AS "First"
FROM v_spending
WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', posted_on) <= to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING min(date_trunc('month', posted_on)) = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Where each account stood before and after the month. Includes internal transfers, because moving money still changes a balance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bal AS (
    SELECT a.name,
           a.opening_balance + coalesce(sum(t.amount)
               FILTER (WHERE t.posted_on < to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM')), 0) AS start_balance,
           a.opening_balance + coalesce(sum(t.amount)
               FILTER (WHERE t.posted_on < to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') + interval '1 month'), 0)
               AS end_balance
    FROM accounts a
    LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.account_id = a.id AND t.status <> 'void'
    WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR a.name = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[]))
    GROUP BY a.name, a.opening_balance
)
SELECT name          AS "Account",
       start_balance AS "Start of month",
       end_balance   AS "End of month",
       end_balance - start_balance AS "Change"
FROM bal
ORDER BY abs(end_balance - start_balance) DESC

panels.title: Every Transaction
panels.description: The whole month, line by line - income, spending and internal transfers alike, which is why Amount is signed: negative left your accounts, positive arrived. Follows the category selectors, so narrowing them turns this into the ledger for just that part of the month. The footer totals Amount; with everything selected that matches the Net tile, because each transfer's two legs cancel - unless a transfer straddles the month end, in which case one leg lands here without its partner and the two figures differ by that amount.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(posted_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
       account                  AS "Account",
       coalesce(direction, '-') AS "Direction",
       coalesce(merchant, description, raw_description) AS "Merchant",
       coalesce(category_path, 'Uncategorized')         AS "Category",
       amount                   AS "Amount",
       is_internal              AS "Internal"
FROM v_transactions
WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') AND (array_length(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll1 = ANY(ARRAY[${category:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll2 = ANY(ARRAY[${subcategory:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND (array_length(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR roll3 = ANY(ARRAY[${subdivision:sqlstring}]::text[]))
ORDER BY "time", amount

panels.title: Needs Attention
panels.description: Spending this month with no category yet. Clearing this before you read the charts above is what keeps a review honest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(posted_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date",
       account     AS "Account",
       coalesce(merchant, description) AS "Merchant",
       outflow     AS "Amount"
FROM v_spending
WHERE (array_length(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[], 1) IS NULL OR account = ANY(ARRAY[${account:sqlstring}]::text[])) AND date_trunc('month', "time") = to_date('$month', 'YYYY-MM') AND category_id IS NULL
ORDER BY outflow DESC LIMIT 20
